explanation: Fires only in the original phase at positions 2-7 (peak t=3-4) and on the <DEL> step (8.5% of mass); never at t=0-1 and never in the copy phase. Token-selective: d (rate 27%), s (23%), x (17%) are strongest, then y, 1, i, t, u, r at about 10%; almost always the first occurrence of that token (in_first=1 holds 91% of mass). Rate is higher when the sequence starts with z/b (and l/k), and activations tend to come in runs of consecutive steps. Top activations (around 0.9-1.0 of max) are d or s at t=3-4. Does not fire on repeated tokens or late positions (t>=8). The rule is graded and depends on history, so a boolean predicate reaches only about F1 0.56 on dev (mass recall 0.71).
